title: Extremely optimized
description: A lightweight and highly optimized Minecraft Java Edition modpack focused on boosting FPS, reducing lag, and improving overall game stability without changing the core vanilla experience.
body:
Extremely optimised is a lightweight and highly optimized Minecraft Java Edition modpack focused on boosting FPS, reducing lag, and improving overall game stability without changing the core vanilla experience. Designed for low-end PCs, mid-range systems, and competitive players who want smooth gameplay, fast loading times, and better performance in single-player and multiplayer.

The modpack includes advanced optimization mods for:

Higher FPS and smoother chunk rendering
Faster world loading and reduced RAM usage
Better server and client performance
Improved lighting and entity optimization
Reduced stuttering and lag spikes
Faster texture and resource loading
Multiplayer optimization and network improvements
